sloka: अथोवाच पुनः सीतामसम्भ्रान्तो विनीतवत् ।प्रगृहीताञ्जलिर्हर्षात् सीतायाः प्रमुखे स्थितः ।। ६.११६.३० ।।
transliteration: athovāca punaḥ sītāmasambhrānto vinītavat ।pragṛhītāñjalirharṣāt sītāyāḥ pramukhe sthitaḥ ।। 6.116.30 ।।

translations.english: "I desire to kill all those Rakshasas who in the past have intimidated you indeed and whoever threatened you."
